description: Πίνακας συλληφθέντων αλλοδαπών για παράνομη είσοδο και παραμονή από Αστυνομικές και Λιμενικές Αρχές ανά υπηκοότητα is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΠΡΟΣΤΑΣΙΑΣ ΣΥΝΟΡΩΝ / A.E.A.. Týka sa cudzincov, ktorí boli zatknutí za nelegálny vstup a pobyt políciou a prístavnými orgánmi krajiny na základe občianstva. Coverage: ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΠΡΟΣΤΑΣΙΑΣ ΣΥΝΟΡΩΝ / A.E.A.. The portal shows the English title as "Lista de extranjeros detenidos por entrada y estancia ilegales por la policía y las autoridades portuarias por nacionali" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΠΡΟΣΤΑΣΙΑΣ ΣΥΝΟΡΩΝ / A.E.A.. Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, Αλλοδαποί, Προστασία συνόρων, Αστυνομία, Μετανάστευση, repository.data.gov.gr. The listing shows 4 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
